questions.stemHtml: The price of cooking oil rises by 25%. By what percentage must a family reduce its consumption of oil so that its expenditure on oil does not change?
questions.solutionHtml:
Expenditure = price × quantity. If price becomes 1.25 times, quantity must become 1/1.25 = 0.8 times to keep the product unchanged.

Reduction = 1 − 0.8 = 0.2, i.e. 20%. (25% is the common trap: a 25% cut would make expenditure 1.25 × 0.75 = 0.9375, a fall.)

questions.stemHtml: A trader marks his goods 40% above cost price and allows two successive discounts of 10% and 5% on the marked price. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solutionHtml:
Let cost = 100. Marked price = 140. After 10% discount: 126. After a further 5%: 126 × 0.95 = 119.7.

Profit = 19.7 on 100, i.e. 19.7%. Adding discounts (15%) and computing 140 × 0.85 = 119 gives the wrong 19%-type answers.

questions.stemHtml: Vessel A contains milk and water in the ratio 5 : 3, and vessel B contains milk and water in the ratio 2 : 3. In what ratio should the contents of A and B be mixed to get a mixture with milk and water in equal quantities?
questions.solutionHtml:
Fraction of milk: A = 5/8 = 0.625, B = 2/5 = 0.4, required = 0.5.

By alligation, A : B = (0.5 − 0.4) : (0.625 − 0.5) = 0.1 : 0.125 = 4 : 5.

Check: 4 parts of A give 2.5 milk, 5 parts of B give 2 milk; total milk 4.5 out of 9 = 1/2. ✓

questions.stemHtml: A can complete a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. They work together for 4 days, after which A leaves. C then joins B, and the two finish the remaining job in 3 days. In how many days can C alone complete the whole job?
questions.solutionHtml:
A + B per day = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36. In 4 days: 20/36 = 5/9 of the job. Remaining = 4/9.

B + C finish 4/9 in 3 days ⇒ (B + C) per day = 4/27. C per day = 4/27 − 1/18 = 8/54 − 3/54 = 5/54.

C alone needs 54/5 = 10.8 days.

questions.stemHtml: A boat takes 10 hours to travel 48 km upstream and 72 km downstream. It takes 10 hours 30 minutes to travel 36 km upstream and 108 km downstream. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.solutionHtml:
Let 1/u = a and 1/d = b (u, d = upstream and downstream speeds). Then 48a + 72b = 10 and 36a + 108b = 10.5.

Multiply the first by 3 and the second by 4: 144a + 216b = 30 and 144a + 432b = 42 ⇒ 216b = 12 ⇒ b = 1/18, so d = 18. Then 48a = 10 − 4 = 6 ⇒ a = 1/8, so u = 8.

Stream speed = (18 − 8)/2 = 5 km/h (boat speed in still water = 13 km/h).

questions.stemHtml: The difference between the compound interest (compounded annually) and the simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 10% per annum is ₹1,240. What is the sum?
questions.solutionHtml:
For principal P: CI = P(1.1³ − 1) = 0.331P and SI = P × 0.1 × 3 = 0.3P. Difference = 0.031P.

0.031P = 1,240 ⇒ P = ₹40,000.

(Using the two-year formula P(r/100)² = 0.01P by mistake would give ₹1,24,000.)

questions.stemHtml: The average score of 25 students in a test is 62. When the score of one more student is included, the average rises by 0.5. What is the score of the new student?
questions.solutionHtml:
Total of 25 students = 25 × 62 = 1,550. New total of 26 students = 26 × 62.5 = 1,625.

New student's score = 1,625 − 1,550 = 75.

Shortcut: the newcomer must bring 62 for himself plus 0.5 for each of the 26 students: 62 + 13 = 75.

questions.stemHtml: The ratio of the present ages of a father and his son is 7 : 2. After 10 years the ratio will be 9 : 4. What is the father's present age?
questions.solutionHtml:
Let the ages be 7x and 2x. Then (7x + 10)/(2x + 10) = 9/4 ⇒ 28x + 40 = 18x + 90 ⇒ 10x = 50 ⇒ x = 5.

Father's present age = 7 × 5 = 35 years (son 10; after 10 years 45 : 20 = 9 : 4 ✓).

questions.stemHtml: α and β are the roots of x² − 6x + k = 0, and α² + β² = 20. What is the value of α³ + β³?
questions.solutionHtml:
α + β = 6 and αβ = k. α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ = 36 − 2k = 20 ⇒ k = 8.

α³ + β³ = (α + β)³ − 3αβ(α + β) = 216 − 3 × 8 × 6 = 216 − 144 = 72.

(Check: the roots are 2 and 4; 8 + 64 = 72.)

questions.stemHtml: How many integers x satisfy |x − 3| + |x + 2| ≤ 9?
questions.solutionHtml:
For −2 ≤ x ≤ 3 the sum equals the distance between −2 and 3, i.e. 5 ≤ 9, so all 6 integers −2, …, 3 work.

For x > 3: (x − 3) + (x + 2) = 2x − 1 ≤ 9 ⇒ x ≤ 5 → x = 4, 5.

For x < −2: (3 − x) + (−x − 2) = 1 − 2x ≤ 9 ⇒ x ≥ −4 → x = −4, −3.

Integers from −4 to 5: 10.

questions.stemHtml: If log2 x + log4 x + log16 x = 7, what is x?
questions.solutionHtml:
log4 x = (log2 x)/2 and log16 x = (log2 x)/4.

So log2 x × (1 + 1/2 + 1/4) = 7 ⇒ log2 x × 7/4 = 7 ⇒ log2 x = 4 ⇒ x = 16.

questions.stemHtml: A triangle has sides 13 cm, 14 cm and 15 cm. What is the radius of its circumcircle?
questions.solutionHtml:
Semi-perimeter s = 21. Area (Heron) = √(21 × 8 × 7 × 6) = √7056 = 84 cm².

Circumradius R = abc/(4 × Area) = (13 × 14 × 15)/(4 × 84) = 2730/336 = 65/8 cm (= 8.125 cm).

(4 cm would be the inradius, Area/s.)

questions.stemHtml: In a circle, a chord of length 24 cm is at a distance of 5 cm from the centre. What is the length of a chord of the same circle that is 12 cm from the centre?
questions.solutionHtml:
The perpendicular from the centre bisects a chord. Radius = √(12² + 5²) = 13 cm.

For a chord 12 cm from the centre, half-length = √(13² − 12²) = 5 cm, so the chord is 10 cm.

questions.stemHtml: A solid metal cylinder of radius 6 cm and height 15 cm is melted and recast into solid cones, each of radius 3 cm and height 5 cm. How many cones are obtained (assume no wastage)?
questions.solutionHtml:
Volume of cylinder = π × 6² × 15 = 540π cm³. Volume of one cone = (1/3) × π × 3² × 5 = 15π cm³.

Number of cones = 540π / 15π = 36.

questions.stemHtml: What is the area of the triangle with vertices (1, 2), (5, −1) and (4, 6)?
questions.solutionHtml:
Area = ½ |x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)| = ½ |1(−1 − 6) + 5(6 − 2) + 4(2 + 1)| = ½ |−7 + 20 + 12| = ½ × 25 = 12.5 sq. units.

(25 is the trap of forgetting the ½.)

questions.stemHtml: What is the remainder when 785 is divided by 9?
questions.solutionHtml:
Powers of 7 modulo 9: 7¹ ≡ 7, 7² = 49 ≡ 4, 7³ ≡ 4 × 7 = 28 ≡ 1. The pattern repeats every 3 powers.

85 = 3 × 28 + 1, so 785 ≡ (7³)28 × 7 ≡ 7 (mod 9). Remainder = 7.

questions.stemHtml: How many even divisors does 2160 have?
questions.solutionHtml:
2160 = 2⁴ × 3³ × 5. Total divisors = (4 + 1)(3 + 1)(1 + 1) = 40.

Odd divisors use 2⁰ only: (3 + 1)(1 + 1) = 8. Even divisors = 40 − 8 = 32 (equivalently, the power of 2 can be 1 to 4: 4 × 4 × 2 = 32).

questions.stemHtml: In how many distinct ways can the letters of the word BANANA be arranged so that the two N's are not next to each other?
questions.solutionHtml:
Total distinct arrangements = 6!/(3! × 2!) = 60.

With the two N's together (treat NN as one block): arrange B, A, A, A, NN = 5!/3! = 20.

Required = 60 − 20 = 40.

questions.stemHtml: Two fair dice are rolled. Given that the sum of the two numbers is at least 9, what is the probability that their product is a multiple of 3?
questions.solutionHtml:
Outcomes with sum at least 9 (all equally likely): sum 9 — (3,6), (4,5), (5,4), (6,3); sum 10 — (4,6), (5,5), (6,4); sum 11 — (5,6), (6,5); sum 12 — (6,6). That is 10 outcomes.

The product is a multiple of 3 when at least one die shows 3 or 6: (3,6), (6,3), (4,6), (6,4), (5,6), (6,5), (6,6) — 7 outcomes.

Probability = 7/10. (5/9 is the unconditional probability 1 − (4/6)², which ignores the given condition.)

Growth from Q1 to Q4: Televisions 65/120 ≈ 54.2%; Refrigerators 5/90 ≈ 5.6%; Washing machines 8/70 ≈ 11.4%; Air conditioners −5/60 ≈ −8.3%; Small appliances 22/40 = 55%.

Small appliances (55%) edge out Televisions (54.2%), which have the largest absolute increase but a bigger base.

questions.stemHtml: Air conditioners accounted for approximately what percentage of the company's total revenue for the year?
questions.solutionHtml:
Annual revenue of air conditioners = 60 + 140 + 45 + 55 = 300. Company total = 380 + 500 + 440 + 475 = 1,795.

Share = 300/1,795 ≈ 16.7%. (20% would come from dividing by 1,500 instead of the actual total of 1,795.)

questions.stemHtml: The company's profit margins (profit as a percentage of revenue) for the year were: Televisions 12%, Refrigerators 8%, Washing machines 10%, Air conditioners 15% and Small appliances 20%. Which product line earned the second-highest profit for the year?
questions.solutionHtml:
Annual revenues: Televisions 600, Refrigerators 400, Washing machines 300, Air conditioners 300, Small appliances 195.

Profits: Televisions 72; Refrigerators 32; Washing machines 30; Air conditioners 45; Small appliances 39.

The highest is Televisions; the second-highest is Air conditioners (₹45 crore). Small appliances have the best margin but a much smaller revenue base.

questions.stemHtml: The interview conversion rate of a programme is the number admitted divided by the number shortlisted. Which programme improved its interview conversion rate from 2024 to 2025?
questions.solutionHtml:
Conversion rates 2024 → 2025: General Management 240/1,200 = 20% → 250/1,300 ≈ 19.2%; Finance 150/900 ≈ 16.7% → 160/1,000 = 16%; Marketing 120/700 ≈ 17.1% → 115/700 ≈ 16.4%; Human Resources 90/500 = 18% → 95/540 ≈ 17.6%; Business Analytics 100/450 ≈ 22.2% → 150/600 = 25%.

Only Business Analytics improved; every other programme's conversion rate fell.
